decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends core spraying competence into corrosion-protection niches, and with no clear performance shortfall the firm's slack lets it carry the product while its results mature.
The multi-model transfer pump line sits on core conveying know-how and in-house manufacturing and likely meets aspirations, so dropping it would destroy value without any problemistic trigger.

Fire protection flow monitoring fits the digitalization strategy and is featured prominently, so despite uncertain adoption the available slack argues for giving it more time rather than reallocating resources.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched in 2024 and is close to the established offer, so it is too early to judge it against aspirations and its low incremental risk justifies keeping it.
